verdict.rationale: Godot is a locally-run, open-source game engine, not a hosted service or AI product that collects/retains user data on a vendor's behalf; there is no cloud account, telemetry-driven data store, or user data pipeline for which retention/deletion controls would be a meaningful axis. This privacy-posture story applies to SaaS/AI-data products, not to a local engine binary, so it is a category mismatch rather than a missing feature.
